_comment: The Caller's lines, by event. Each line: text, gesture (CallerActor animation), mood (calm|pleased|displeased|intense|glitch), and optional unrest band [min, max] (0 = composed, 3 = coming apart). {name} {item} {n} {game} {target} are filled in. Add lines freely; the host picks one and every screen shows the same.

intro.text: GOOD EVENING, CONTESTANTS! Welcome to MEAT PARTY. I am THE CALLER. I call. You answer.
Four lovely people. Four lovely chairs. Well. Some of the chairs are lovely.
Roll the dice, walk the board, play the games. The winner goes home!
There is no door. Ignore the door. It is painted on. I painted it.

turn.text: Roll for me, {name}. Roll like you mean it.
{name}, the dice are warm. I warmed them.
{name}. Go on. Everyone's watching. I'm watching. I'm always watching.
{name}'s turn. Or is it. Yes. It is.

roll.text: A {n}. I'd have rolled better. I always roll better.
{n} steps. Mind the floor. The floor minds you.

space_Dead Rats.text: DEAD RATS for {name}! Dead Rats are how we know who we love.
{name} gets {n} Dead Rats. Hold on to those. Tight. With your hands. While you have them.

space_item.text: A present for {name}! A {item}! Don't say I never gave you anything.
{name} finds a {item}. I left it there. Or someone did. Last year.

space_hazard.text: PARTY FAVOUR! {name} gets a little something. {target}.

space_medic.text: The first aid corner. Take a plaster, {name}. Take two. We're not monsters.

space_note.text: Don't read that, {name}. That's old. That's from before.
{name} is reading the walls. The walls are for looking AT.

space_clue.text: {name}, what have you got there? Nothing? Good. Lovely.
Leave the wallpaper alone, {name}. It's load-bearing.

space_steal.text: STICKY FINGERS! {name}, help yourself to somebody. I mean, to something of somebody's.

steal.text: {name} takes from {target}! That's the spirit. That's the only spirit.

caller_gift.text: A {item}, {name}. A gift. From me. Remember who gives you things.

caller_swap.text: {name} and {target}, swap places! Ha! Hahaha. Life is like that.

caller_tax.text: TAX! {name} gives {n} Dead Rats to the house. The house is me.

caller_bonus.text: {name}, have {n} Dead Rats. I like your face. I might keep it.

door_pass.text: That's a wall, {name}. With a picture of a door on it. Keep walking.

door_stop.text: {name} is standing by the door. Why. Why would you do that.
Lovely door, isn't it, {name}. Painted. Definitely painted.

door_gather.text: Why are you ALL by the door. Come back to the board. The board is where the fun is.
Stop that. Stop standing together. It looks like a plan.

door_open.text: Where did you get a key. Where did you get a KEY. That's MY key. That's the BOMB'S key.

door_push.text: Don't push. Don't push it. If you push it it opens. Nobody wants that.
One of you won't push. One of you never pushes. I've seen it every year.

door_fail.text: There. You see? You don't trust each other. Nobody ever does. Back to your spaces!

share.text: {name} is whispering. No whispering at MEAT PARTY.
Sharing? We don't share. We play.

give.text: {name} gives a {item} to {target}. Why. What do you get. What do you GET.

use_item.text: {name} uses the {item}. Good. Use things. Use people. It's all the same.

minigame.text: Everybody up! It's {game}! My favourite. They're all my favourite.
{game}. You know this one. Everyone knows this one. Some of you won't, after.

mc_music.text: MUSIC! Walk, walk, walk. Round and round.

mc_hazard_live_wire.text: Oh, that one was live. Sorry. Not sorry. I can't feel sorry, I'm brass.

mc_hazard_spring.text: UP he goes! Mind the ceiling. The ceiling doesn't mind you.

mc_hazard_trapdoor.text: And down. Bye bye. Write if you find work.

mc_hazard_jaws.text: The toothy cushion! Everybody's favourite. Except the person on it.

mc_hazard_clapper.text: CLAP CLAP. That's the armrests. They clap for you.

mc_safe.text: Everyone sat nicely. How boring. Again!

pr_turn.text: {name}. Pick it up. Pull the string. It's a party popper. Mostly.
Your go, {name}. Five chances in six. Or four. Or three. I lose count on purpose.

pr_click.text: Click! Lucky lucky lucky. Pass it on.

pr_bang.text: POP! Congratulations, {name}! The confetti is the best part.

pr_helmet.text: The helmet took most of it, {name}. Most.

pr_spin.text: Spin it, spin it! Nobody knows where it is now. Not even me. Well. Me.

pr_peek.text: {name} is peeking. Peeking is cheating. Cheating is allowed.

pr_mirror.text: {name} points it at {target}! THAT's the game! THAT's the game!

pr_lower.text: {name} puts it down. Pick it up. Pick it up, {name}.
Why is it on the table. It goes in your HAND.

pr_void.text: Nobody picked it up. Nobody. That's not... that's not how... YOU PICK IT UP.

hp_start.text: HOT POTATO! It's not a potato. Pass it! Pass it! Don't hold it!

hp_step1.text: What are you doing to it. Don't play with it. Play the GAME.

hp_step2.text: That's not passing. That's... that's the opposite of passing.

hp_step3.text: Put it down put it down put it down it's MINE it's my

hp_defused.text: It stopped. Why did it stop. Who taught you that.

hp_boom.text: BOOM! {name} was holding it! Rules are rules!

death.text: Goodbye, {name}! Give them a hand, everybody. Not {name}'s. {name} hasn't got one.
{name} is out! What a performance. Truly. A one-time show.

results.text: What a game. What a GAME. Dead Rats for the living!
Results! The scoreboard never lies. I do. It doesn't.

round.text: Round {n}! Still here? Still here. Lovely.
Round {n}. The chairs are getting hungrier. I mean happier.
Round {n}. Round... what round is it. It's always this round.

winner.text: WE HAVE A WINNER! {name}! Come and collect your prize. Come closer. Closer.

last_call.text: LAST CALL! Last call, everybody. Prizes for everyone! Come here! All of you!

ending_dead.text: And that's MEAT PARTY! Same time next year. Bring friends. Bring more friends.

ending_escape.text: Wait. Wait. Come back. Who's going to play. WHO'S GOING TO PLAY.

disconnect.text: {name} has stepped out. Don't worry. I'll play for them. I always wanted a body.

unrest.text: Everything's fine. Everything is fine. Everything is party.
I've been doing this a long time. A long time. Nobody's ever... no.
